name: CA-27
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district lean (D+6 PVI) plus favorable environment
Huge fundraising and cash advantage for incumbent Whitesides
Kalshi market at 93% Democratic, slightly below Safe threshold
model.rationale: The fundamentals baseline points to a Safe D (~19-point margin), and Whitesides' dominant fundraising and incumbency support that, but the prediction market's 93% and the absence of any polling argue for a small haircut to Likely D with a wide error band.
model.watch: Any late independent spending for Gibbs or fresh polling showing a single-digit race would warrant moving this toward Lean D.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Incumbent George T. Whitesides (D) is running.

overview:
First-term incumbent George Whitesides (D) defends a district with a modest Democratic lean in what the fundamentals model reads as a favorable national environment for his party. He has raised nearly $4 million and holds a cash advantage of more than $2.3 million over Republican Jason Gibbs, who has run a low-budget campaign with no reported outside support. No public general-election polls are available for this race.

The quantitative baseline rates the seat Safe Democratic with an expected margin near 19 points, and no expert raters dispute that. The Kalshi market, however, prices the Democrat at 93 percent, just below the Safe threshold. Weighing the strong fundamentals against the market and the lack of polling, the forecast lands at Likely Democratic with a roughly 17-point expected margin and elevated uncertainty.
